title: 第920章 疼痛守恒第919章 不要停
lines: 由于赵真襄不断害羞，吴谦也只好趁势改变。
找到一个让她更好接受，也无法推辞的说法。
东西是你弄坏的，当然要你亲自负责！
赵真襄是奔着助吴谦疗伤而来，现在不光没把伤养好，还多添一处伤势。
她心里自然不好过。
再加上后来又被吴谦灌输了一脑子双修的鸡汤。
如今功还没练，就先把练功的家伙事给整坏了，就更加心中煎熬。
她为了弥补过错，无论吴谦说什么，都不再心生不满，只求尽快为吴谦修复创伤。
所以，在听到吴谦的要求后，赵真襄立即答应下来，一心用行动来表达自己的歉意。
“是这样么？”
吴谦点点头，一边享受着赵真襄生涩又细腻的抚慰，一边中气不足的虚弱道，
“这样就行，揉揉好多了……”
满意是满意了，但满足还远远达不到。
毕竟飞天上是为了上天的，不是为了做针线活的。
这么一直搞下去，万一真给揉到吐，那就真后力不继了。
于是吴谦略过干瘾后，便开始向着下一步继续迈进。
他先是问赵真襄累不累，在得到否定的答案后，依旧劝赵真襄在云端躺会。
因为她不累，他累！
他累又没能力悬停在半空，所以只能通过赵真襄，来让自己有一处休息的港湾。
照顾到伤员的身体，赵真襄也拿他没办法，只能托举住吴谦柔弱的身躯。
缓缓倒了下去。
赵真襄为了保持距离，尽量把托吴谦的两条胳膊伸直。
可即便如此，两人看似离的很远，却又偏偏离的很近。
赵真襄此时都在怀疑，是不是刚刚救人的时候，把吴谦给拉长了……
眼看就差一点够不着赵真襄，吴谦也急了，当场抗议道，
“咱家就想躺会，你老举着我干什么，还不赶紧把我放下。”
赵真襄倒是想把他放下，但一看到横亘在两人的宏钩，怎么都想不通，该怎么把人放下来……
想到这里，赵真襄为难道，“怎么放，我怕再把你弄折了……”
吴谦一脸生无可恋，知道这是真碰上仙女了。
无奈之下，吴谦只能一步步循循善诱，一点点教赵真襄该怎么放。
才能既不让她被捅个窟窿，也不会让他拦腰折断。
content_en:
Because Zhao Zhenxiang continued to be shy, Wu Qian had no choice but to take advantage of the situation and change.
Find a way to make it easier for her to accept and unable to refuse.
If you broke something, of course you are responsible for it!
Zhao Zhenxiang came here to help Wu Qian heal his injuries, but now he not only failed to heal his injuries, but also got another injury.
Naturally, she felt bad.
In addition, Wu Qian was later instilled in him the chicken soup of dual cultivation.
Now that I haven't even started to practice my skills yet, I've messed up the guy who's practicing the skills first, which makes me even more tormented.
In order to make up for her mistake, she no longer felt dissatisfied no matter what Wu Qian said, she just wanted to repair Wu Qian's wounds as soon as possible.
Therefore, after hearing Wu Qian's request, Zhao Zhenxiang immediately agreed and expressed his apology through actions.
"Is that so?"
Wu Qian nodded, and while enjoying Zhao Zhenxiang's raw and delicate soothing, he said weakly and out of breath,
"That's enough. It feels better after rubbing..."
Satisfaction means satisfaction, but satisfaction is far from being achieved.
After all, flying in the sky is for heaven, not for needlework.
If you keep doing it like this, if you really make yourself vomit, you will really be exhausted.
So after Wu Qian got over the addiction, he began to move towards the next step.
He first asked Zhao Zhenxiang if he was tired. After getting a negative answer, he still advised Zhao Zhenxiang to lie down in the clouds.
Because she is not tired, he is tired!
He was tired and unable to hover in mid-air, so he could only use Zhao Zhenxiang to give himself a haven to rest.
After taking care of the wounded man's body, Zhao Zhenxiang had no choice but to lift Wu Qian's weak body.
Slowly fell down.
In order to keep the distance, Zhao Zhenxiang tried his best to straighten the two arms holding Wu Qian.
But even so, the two seemed far away, but they were very close.
Zhao Zhenxiang was wondering if Wu Qian had been stretched when he rescued people just now...
Seeing that Zhao Zhenxiang was almost out of reach, Wu Qian became anxious and protested on the spot,
"We just want to lie down for a while. Why are you holding me up? Why don't you put me down quickly?"
Zhao Zhenxiang wanted to put him down, but when he saw the huge hook between the two of them, he couldn't figure out how to put him down...
Thinking of this, Zhao Zhenxiang wondered, "How do I let it go? I'm afraid I'll break you again..."
Wu Qian had a look of despair on his face, knowing that he had really met a fairy.
In desperation, Wu Qian could only teach Zhao Zhenxiang step by step how to let go.
Talent would neither let her be poked in a hole nor let him break her waist.
title_en: Chapter 920 Conservation of Pain Chapter 919 Don’t Stop
